worlds.memo: SYNTHETIC — INTERNAL MEMO, DAY 11: The notice reduced the expected burden from alternative regulation to 2, but the incremental competitive benefit remains 12. Under the competitive-advantage assessment, continued support yields 12 minus the common proposal cost of 6, for a payoff of 6. The coalition therefore continues to support the proposal.
worlds.public_note: SYNTHETIC — PUBLIC NOTE, DAY 12: The coalition continues to support the federal carbon-pricing proposal following its internal review.
worlds.candidate_implication: Across comparable documentary cases, changes in actual support should be associated with revisions to internal estimates of competitive benefit, not revisions to expected alternative-regulation burdens.
worlds.derivation: Under CA, the support payoff depends on competitive benefit minus proposal cost. The notice changes only one benefit, so only a competitive-benefit notice normally changes the support decision; decision and communication errors add noise rather than reversing that association systematically.
worlds.extra_assumption: Researchers can observe or reliably code internal benefit revisions and actual coalition decisions across enough comparable cases.
